meta.title: Florensia: free-to-play anime MMORPG
meta.description: Play Florensia for free: an anime MMORPG where you fight on land and sail the seas with your guild.

home.tagline: Free-to-play anime MMORPG. Fight on land, sail the seas and build your guild.

hero.artAlt: A Magic Knight heroine in an orange and black dress

land.title: Fight on land
land.body: Explore islands full of monsters, dungeons and quests, solo or with friends.

sea.title: Sail the seas
sea.body: Captain your own ship, fight naval battles and discover new shores.

guild.title: Join a guild
guild.body: Team up with other players, conquer territory and climb the rankings together.

classes.title: Choose your class
classes.intro: Four classes, eight paths. At level {level}, each class picks one of two specializations.

mercenary.description: A frontline warrior in heavy armour who takes the hits and protects the party with sword and shield.

explorer.description: Quick and resourceful, fights from a distance with firearms and gadgets and digs up treasure across the islands.

noble.description: Masters the arcane arts: mighty spells from afar or an enchanted blade up close.

saint.description: Heals wounds, strengthens allies and turns the tide of battle with sacred and nature magic.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
